title.en: Extending the Effectivity of Presidential Decree Numbered Seventeen Hundred Forty-Five Dated November 20, 1980, as Amended By Presidential Decree Numbered Seventeen Hundred Forty-Seven, Dated December 4, 1980
title.orig: Extending the Effectivity of Presidential Decree Numbered Seventeen Hundred Forty-Five Dated November 20, 1980, as Amended By Presidential Decree Numbered Seventeen Hundred Forty-Seven, Dated December 4, 1980

text.en:
The privilege to apply in writing to the proper authorities in order to avail of the amnesty granted
pursuant to Section 1, Presidential Decree No. 1745, as amended, is intended to December 31, 1981.

The surrender of unlicensed or loose firearm, ammunition or explosive without incurring any criminal
liability therefor pursuant to Section 3, Presidential Decree No. 1745, as amended with corresponding
privileges pursuant to Sections 4 and 5 thereof is extended to December 31, 1981.

All rules and regulations in implementation of Presidential Decree No. 1745, as amended, are made
applicable in the implementation of this order.

This Executive Order takes effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-one.
